review_notes: I read all of lines 1–88: the three theorems mem_sup_centralizer_of_conj_eq, le_sup_centralizer_of_outSolvable and le_sup_centralizer_of_commutator_eq. The only repeated pattern is the proof that an element centralizes K, in `hc` of the first lemma and `hvc` of the third. Both use `Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff`, then a short `calc` closed by `group`. The hypotheses differ, though. In `hc`, x and k induce the same conjugation on K. In `hvc`, v normalizes K and c centralizes K. The reasoning is a few lines of group-word manipulation, so it counts as a short calculation, not substantial repeated machinery. Extracting a shared lemma would not remove nontrivial duplicated reasoning. The second lemma's derived-series argument and the third lemma's commutator expansion each appear once. I did not look for similar patterns in other files, so I can't say whether this pattern recurs elsewhere in the project.
